title: Closing: his own small groups
summary: As the tape runs out he mentions leading his own three-piece sax groups with vocals during the war.

blocks.x: Yeah, that's where we rehearsed, right there. Yeah, it's right there. Yeah, it's right there. There's only about another minute left down here, half a minute. Is there anything else? I think we've covered most of your life. Is there anything else you'd like to add? Well, I'll-
Any other bands or anything else that-
Well, I'll tell you- What you want to say?
You want the bands- Well, we had several set-ups. Well, I'll tell you- Well, I'll tell you- Well, we had several set-ups. Well, I'll tell you- For three pieces.

So for that one, we had a couple of pieces. And then we had a couple of pieces. And then we had a couple of pieces. And so forth. I had several aggregations of my own. But I would take- I don't want- The first part would start by three pieces, Ronnie, during the war. And I would take three pieces and then, in practice, we'd play a marcher with three pieces. Then the fellow would play with six pieces.
What else did you use besides the sax?
Well, we didn't use no more than sax, but we used the vocals. Both-
